drivingQuestion: What does the phrase ״ונגרע מערכך״ add?
outcomeNote: the content of the baraita introduced by תנו רבנן in arakhin.sugya162; a derivation with no exchange

segments.he: ״וְנִגְרַע מֵעֶרְכֶּךָ״, אַף מִן הַהֶקְדֵּשׁ, שֶׁאִם אֲכָלָהּ הֶקְדֵּשׁ שָׁנָה אוֹ שְׁתַּיִם, אִי נָמֵי לֹא אֲכָלָהּ, אֶלָּא שֶׁהָיְתָה לְפָנָיו — נוֹתֵן סֶלַע וּפוּנְדְּיוֹן לְשָׁנָה.
segments.en: The baraita states that the apparently superfluous phrase «“And a deduction shall be made from your valuation”» teaches that «even» the years that passed «from the consecration» of the field are deducted, and not only the years that passed before it was consecrated. «That» is, «if the Temple» treasury «benefited» from the field’s produce for «a year or two, or» if the Temple treasury «did not benefit» from it «but» the field nevertheless «remained before it,» i.e., in the possession of the Temple treasury, «he gives a sela and a pundeyon for» each remaining «year» until the Jubilee Year.

moves.summary: the verse's extra phrase includes the years since consecration
moves.about: the apparently superfluous phrase 'and a deduction shall be made from your valuation' is quoted for exposition
